integrity: The positivity certificate consists of exact rational operations in CHECK.py and an analytic Cauchy remainder estimate and large-gap argument in RESULT.md. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric equispaced three-frequency sums, one exterior evaluation location, and averaged energy on [-1,1]; no unrestricted three-frequency or all-exterior-points claim. A specialized earlier equivalent result is a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp doubled-window extrapolation for symmetric three-frequency Fourier sums
